providers.title: Order relations of the tree positions
providers.scope: Child and parent blocks compare by the parent index: R_i^+(p) < R_{i-1}^+(a) iff pi(p) <= a, and three analogous equivalences.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Properties of the anchor
providers.scope: The anchor S has distinct rows and columns, dense first 32 rows and columns, and all five-bit words in its corner.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No five non-anchor columns are shattered
providers.scope: Non-anchor rows realize at most 27 of the 32 words on any five non-anchor columns.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Anchor rigidity (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every ordered copy of S in A_h uses one position of each anchor group of a single mode, in order.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Copies meet the leaf diagonal (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every ordered copy of H in A_h passes through one of the 2^h diagonal leaf cells, so N_H(A_h) <= 2^h n^130.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Distance from H-freeness (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every H-free binary matrix differs from A_h in at least 4^h cells.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Polynomial ordered removal fails (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A_h is (386h+2)^-2-far from H-free and has at most (386h+2)^-2 2^-h n^132 ordered copies of H.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Canonical row-column sampling
providers.scope: Sampling q rows and q columns finds H in A_h with probability at most eps_h 2^-h q^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
